title: Hurricane Harvey - SAR GoPro Footage (547068)
description: GoPro footage from a search and rescue mission over Houston, TX after Hurricane Harvey. Airmen and assets from the 41st Rescue Squadron at Moody Air Force Base, Ga., are forward deployed to College Station, Texas to support FEMA requests for Hurricane Harvey rescue operations. Hurricane Harvey formed in the Gulf of Mexico and made landfall in southeastern Texas, bringing record flooding and destruction to the region. U.S. military assets supported FEMA as well as state and local authorities in rescue and relief efforts.
